sampling: 5 C_bounded wins and 5 losses per dataset; cases and X/Y assignments shuffled.
reviewer: assistant; model identity and stored verifier labels hidden, not independent human reviewers
assess: check mathematical validity of both outputs
flag suspected verifier/format issues; uncertain stays uncertain
gate: Do not launch seed42 if material unexplained grading/data/code problems are found. Freeze annotations before unblinding. Known output format failures are reported under unchanged verifier. Sampling cannot prove absence of all problems.
